#   LOOPS  repro.hlsl                     the reported nested [unroll] loops
#   FLAT   control-manual-unroll.hlsl     reporter's workaround shape
#   FLAT   control-trivial.hlsl           no loop at all -- SPIR-V availability
#   LOOPS  control-runtime-loop.hlsl      uniform trip count -- detector alive
#   LOOPS  minimal-nested.hlsl            minimal restatement of the repro
#   FLAT   minimal-manual.hlsl            minimal restatement of the workaround
